title: [Decision] Should anyone be able to send an in-app message to the members of a different organization?
body:
triage#1 · baozhoutao · session_01RKKVnggJeBxtQEF8sbEJAW

Filing category: ② a decision only the maintainer can make (tenancy and security boundary).

## 维护者速读

- 现象：今天站内信只能发给「发送方自己所在组织」的人。通知归属的组织取自流程运行时的上下文，拿不到时宁可报错也不猜（`notify-node.ts`，#11303 / #23284）；`role:` / `team:` 也只在本组织内解析。没有任何配置项能「发给另一个组织的成员」。
- 要你裁：要不要支持「指定某个（别的）组织，给它的成员发站内信」，如果支持，谁有权发。
- 推荐：A：不支持，保持站内信严格按组织隔离，并把这条边界写清楚；平台运营方的跨组织公告若有真实需求，作为运营侧能力另行立项。

## One-sentence problem

A user asked whether a message can be sent to "the members of a specified organization"; today it cannot, by construction, and opening it would let one tenant write into another tenant's inbox.

## Evidence

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`: the notification's organization is the run's `tenantId`, else the organization of the record it is about; "There is deliberately NO guessed limb". The node has no target-organization setting.
- `recipient-resolver.ts`: `role:` expansion filters `sys_member` by the emitting organization.
- Prior art for a platform-level sender: #25413 delivers the access-upgrade report in-app into the organization `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_ORGANIZATION` names — a deployment-configured target, not a user-chosen one.

## Governing text

- ADR-0131 (total organization ownership; epic #15204): every row carries its organization; a write into another organization is the wall the platform defends.
- ADR-0030 single ingress: whatever is decided, the send goes through `emit()`.

## Options

| Option | What it does | What the customer sees | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Keep in-app messages organization-bound; document it on the notify node and in the admin docs | "Specify an organization" is not offered; each organization's admin sends to their own members | docs only |
| B | Platform-operator-only cross-organization send: a deployment-level administrator picks one or more organizations; each gets its own `sys_notification` stamped with that organization | A hosted operator can post a maintenance notice to tenants | server lane + cloud operator surface · several PRs · no precedent beyond #25413 |
| C | Let any flow or admin name a target organization | Any tenant admin can message another tenant's members | server lane · 1–2 PRs, plus a security review |

Business reading: A = tenants are separate companies; B = the landlord can post a notice in every building; C = any tenant can post in another tenant's lobby.

## Recommendation

A. Two years out, multi-tenant platforms keep tenant-to-tenant messaging closed and give only the operator a broadcast channel (Salesforce trust notifications, Atlassian / Microsoft 365 service notices) — and that operator channel belongs to the hosting product, not to the open runtime. Not B now: no measured demand and the operator surface lives on the cloud side; it can return as its own card. Not C: it breaks the organization wall ADR-0131 defends, and a mistake there is a silent cross-tenant write. Confidence gap: whether self-hosted single-company deployments with several organizations (subsidiaries) want an HQ-to-all send — unmeasured.
Self-check: only ① picks A; ②③④ do not flip it.

## After the ruling

A: docs seat adds one sentence to the notify node reference and the admin notification docs ("a notification reaches members of the organization it was emitted in"); close. B: file a cloud card for the operator surface plus a server card for an operator-only emit path with an audit row per target organization.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A 维持「通知属于一个组织」这一已立契约，不加特例；C 在组织墙上开口子。
② 实际业务拉动: 仅本次会话的一句提问；未见具体租户场景。零拉动默认不做。
③ 防 AI 犯错: A 下 agent 无法跨组织写；C 下一个写错的组织 ID 就是静默的跨租户投递。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: A 零新增义务；B 需要新的运营侧界面与审计。
Prior rulings read: "notify another organization" → 108 hits (#23284, #25413); "cross-organization notify" → 22 hits (#24785, #13546 wall defects); ADR-0131, ADR-0030; thread: none

Reader who acts: the docs seat (A) or the server and cloud seats (B), after the ruling.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue cross-organization notify` → 22 hits, none on choosing a target organization; `notify another organization` → 108 hits, none.
